sections.name: Verse 1
lines: At the cross of Christ we bow;
Take our guilt and grief away;
Hear and heal us now, we pray.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Now, O Lord, this very hour,
Send Thy grace and show Thy power;
While we rest upon Thy word,
Come, and bless us now, O Lord!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Mercy now, O Lord, we plead
In this hour of utter need;

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: Rising o'er us like the sun,
Light and life art Thou within:
